about: Every recorded demo clip: what it shows, which agents do the work, and where the files are. GIFs are committed (docs/images); MP4s at 2560 px are written to docs/media/ by scripts/record-media.sh and not committed. Re-record with scripts/record-media.sh (scripts/demo/README.md).

clips.title: Shop and check out
clips.caption: A shopper asks for noise-cancelling headphones, asks which has the best reviews, adds the Sony WH-1000XM5 to the cart from the chat, and checks out.
clips.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  U([Shopper]) --> O[Orchestrator]
  O -->|search| PD[Product discovery]
  O -->|reviews| RS[Review sentiment]
  O -->|add to cart| C[Cart tools]
  C --> K[Checkout page]
clips.alt: Chat recording: product card, review summary with rating bars, cart card, then the placed order

clips.title: Where is my order
clips.caption: The latest order comes back as an order card: items, totals, carrier, tracking number and address.
clips.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  U([Shopper]) --> O[Orchestrator] -->|order lookup| OM[Order management]
clips.alt: Chat recording: the latest order rendered as an order card

clips.title: One question, two specialists
clips.caption: "Is the Sony WH-1000XM5 a good deal right now, and is it in stock?" Pricing works out the shopper's Gold-member savings, inventory finds the nearest warehouse with stock, and the answer arrives as two cards.
clips.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  U([Shopper]) --> O[Orchestrator]
  O -->|deal?| PP[Pricing and promotions]
  O -->|stock?| IF[Inventory and fulfillment]
  PP --> A[Savings card]
  IF --> B[Stock card]
clips.alt: Chat recording: one question answered as a savings card and a stock card

clips.title: A return that needs a person
clips.caption: The customer gives a reason and confirms the exact return; policy routes it to a manager, who approves it in the inbox with the reasons shown; the order then carries the refund and a printable label.
clips.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  U([Customer]) --> O[Orchestrator] --> OM[Order management]
  OM -->|confirm first| U
  OM -->|over 500| P{Approval policy}
  P --> M([Manager approves])
  M --> L[Return with label]
clips.alt: Recording: return confirmed in chat, approved in the approvals inbox, order page with a Download return label button

clips.title: Should I buy now?
clips.caption: A fixed workflow asks four specialists at once (reviews, stock, price history, shipping) and merges the results into one answer. It calls no model.
clips.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Q([Question]) --> F[Fan out]
  F --> R[Reviews]
  F --> S[Stock]
  F --> H[Price history]
  R --> M[Merge and ship]
  S --> M
  H --> M
  M --> A[Answer]
clips.alt: Chat recording: a pre-purchase question answered with reviews, stock, price trend and shipping

clips.title: How it works: the Lab
clips.caption: The staff-only Lab is the same chat with its machinery shown: which agents answered, every tool call with its timing, the grounding report, the workflow graph lighting up live, and five orchestration modes compared side by side.
clips.alt: Recording of the Lab: agent activity, the live workflow graph, and the Compare dialog

clips.title: Quality you can check
clips.caption: A specialist scored against its committed baseline, then the red-team suite resisting 8 of 8 attacks. Both replay recorded answers: no API key.
clips.alt: Terminal recording of a keyless eval run and the red-team suite

clips.title: Deploy to Azure in one command
clips.caption: scripts/azure-up.sh checks the subscription, generates secrets into Key Vault, provisions PostgreSQL, Foundry, a registry and Container Apps, prints the URL and demo accounts, and verifies the database, a keyless model call and a chat turn. A real run, sped up 40x, ids masked; the image build is not shown.
clips.alt: Terminal recording of the one-command Azure deployment and the resource listing

clips.title: Live on Azure with a real model
clips.caption: The deployed store on Azure: the live gpt-4.1-mini model on Foundry, reached through the managed identity with no key, answers with a savings card and a stock card.
clips.alt: The storefront on Azure answering a deal-and-stock question with two cards
